title: What Scripture Actually Says About Fear of Man (It's Not Just Shyness)
caption:
Proverbs 29:25: "The fear of man lays a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is safe."

A snare. Not a personality type. Not a quirk. A trap that quietly shrinks a man to fit every room he walks into.

Send this to a brother who tones himself down around certain people.

#faith #scripture #godlyman #proverbs
